subject: Lateral move: coverage & backfill strategy (need approval)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Erin Reyes <erin.recruit@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Lateral move: coverage & backfill strategy (need approval)

Team — quick heads up. Sam Patel (Senior Infra Engineer, Platform) has accepted an internal lateral to the Serving Runtime team; his move will be effective 2027-09-15. This is great for cross-team talent but it leaves a gap in the Dedicated infra squad that we need to address before we lose coverage for two Q4 launches.

Ask: I need approval to open a 1.0 FTE backfill requisition now and to use an interim contractor for up to 8 weeks while we run a targeted hire. Rationale and options attached (org-chart-q3.png, cost-estimate-headcount.xlsx).

Option A (preferred): Backfill with Senior Infra hire (permanent) — ~10–12 week ramp but preserves capacity for Q4 and reduces cross-training overhead.
Option B: Use two 0.6 contractors to cover immediate pager/oncall gaps — faster onboarding but higher short-term cost and knowledge fragmentation.

Impact if we do nothing: increased incident MTTR risk during releases, deferred platform improvements, and a deployment capacity shortfall for the Dedicated product upgrade slated for Oct.

Budget note: I estimate the full-year incremental spend (if we recruit mid-Q3) at ~60% of a headcount pro-rated for 2027; the attached sheet breaks down the commit. I want to confirm approval to proceed with Option A and to start the Workday requisition (REQ-4521) and engage TalentBridge to source candidates.

Next steps I propose: 1) Laura — quick sign-off on headcount and hiring plan, 2) Marcus — confirm interim coverage plan from Platform SRE, 3) Evelyn — HR to create the requisition & confirm hiring timeline.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org-chart-q3.png (image), cost-estimate-headcount.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Erin Reyes <erin.recruit@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T13:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Lateral move: coverage & backfill strategy (need approval)

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. High level: I approve opening a permanent backfill requisition for the role. A couple of items before you start the req:

- Can you confirm the hiring level and target compensation band (IC4 vs IC5)? Put the recommended band on the requisition so HR and recruiting can align.
- Please quantify the expected Q4 risk in one paragraph (e.g., % of deployments impacted or an illustrative incident scenario); I may need to surface this in the quarterly capacity review.
- If we go with a contractor interim, provide an owner for vendor engagement and cost center to charge. We should avoid mixing funding streams.

If you can get me the compensation band and the short risk paragraph by EOD tomorrow I will greenlight the req and the contract up to 8 weeks. Good to engage Erin now to run a shortlist.

—Laura
VP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-26T10:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Lateral move: coverage & backfill strategy (need approval)

On Thu, Aug 25, 2027 at 13:08, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. High level: I approve opening a permanent backfill requisition for the role.

Jordan — operational notes from Platform/SRE perspective: we can cover the critical oncall windows by rotating two engineers from infra-core for the next 6 weeks and scheduling a focused knowledge-transfer plan with Sam before he transitions. That reduces the immediate risk. Marcus (SRE) can own the rotation.

However, two constraints: 1) rotating engineers will delay planned non-critical work by ~30%, and 2) we will need a formal handover document (I can template it). If Laura signs off on the band and Evelyn kicks off the req, I can commit to the rotation and run the KT sessions.

Interim vendor approach is okay if recruiting doesn't surface candidates within 3 weeks. Erin — can you confirm contractor daily rates (onshore) and availability?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Platform SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Erin Reyes <erin.recruit@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-08-28T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Lateral move: coverage & backfill strategy (need approval)

Thanks all — HR notes and next steps: 

1) Jordan: please send the recommended compensation band and the 1-paragraph risk statement (Laura asked) so HR can map to an appropriate job profile.
2) Once we have that, I will create REQ-4521 in Workday and route it for budget sign-off. Expect 24–48 hours for internal approvals if the band is within the forecast.
3) Erin: please open a contingency contractor requisition in parallel (label it "Contingency - Infra Backfill") and provide rate cards for up to 8 weeks so we can authorize vendor engagement quickly if needed.
4) Marcus: your rotation plan + KT template would be helpful; attach to the Workday requisition as supporting docs to justify the timeline.

I will also flag this in the next HR weekly with finance to speed budget routing. Tentative timeline: submit req by 2027-08-29, approvals complete by 2027-09-01, candidate shortlist in two weeks.

Evelyn Hart
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
